target_customer.title: Target Customer
target_customer.content: The primary target customer for the AI Tutor is MBA students in the United States. While there is reported general familiarity with AI tools among K-12 students, with some data suggesting over half of US students aged 13-17 have used AI for research and ChatGPT leading student usage at 66%, specific data for MBA students is lacking. This inference of AI familiarity and usage among MBA students based on K-12 student data is an unconfirmed assumption due to demographic mismatch. A significant adoption barrier is the relatively low perception of AI's benefits in education within the US, where some reports indicate only 39% of respondents view it as beneficial. Additionally, higher education faculty show a low adoption rate of generative AI (22%) compared to 83% of K-12 teachers [web-236a31a2f5a04bcb8b4ae6d39dee9e37], which could influence institutional acceptance and student trust. The precise unmet learning needs, frequency, urgency, and willingness to pay among MBA students for an AI tutor are currently unknown assumptions that require validation.
